query:
SELECT p.id, p.trialId, p.filename, p.createdAt,
       CASE WHEN fsd.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Indexed' ELSE 'Processing' END as status
FROM protocols p
LEFT JOIN fileSearchDocuments fsd ON p.id = fsd.protocolId
WHERE p.filename LIKE '%Protocol_Oncology%'
ORDER BY p.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 3;
